I paid the seller directly. Which Superbuy service should I look at?
Read the parcel forwarding guide. It covers items you bought yourself and need received at a Superbuy warehouse. A shopping agent order instead asks Superbuy to make the purchase.
Should I register a forwarding request for an item Superbuy bought for me?
Superbuy says that a purchase made through its shopping agent service does not require a separate forwarding submission. Check the shopping order and its warehouse status first.
Where should I get the address for my forwarding shipment?

Use the receiving address displayed in your own Superbuy forwarding account for the selected warehouse. Copy all the address parts and account-specific identification exactly before sending the seller the delivery instructions.
Can I use the warehouse address from someone else's tutorial?

A screenshot may show an old address or a different user's identifying information. Open your own account, select the applicable warehouse and compare the full address with the seller's order before dispatch.
What if my forwarding item has no marketplace product URL?

Superbuy's forwarding guide describes supplying an item name and type for an already prepared parcel. Describe the actual contents and use the form's current requirements to check whether review is possible.
What do I check before sending a self-purchased item to the warehouse?
Check the forwarding review result, the approved item, the selected warehouse and the receiving instructions. Resolve a restriction or incomplete request before asking your seller to dispatch.
Is the seller's order number the domestic tracking number?

The seller order identifies the purchase. The waybill identifies a physical shipment handled by a carrier. Copy the carrier name and waybill from the dispatch record when completing forwarding logistics.
My seller split a purchase into two boxes. How should I record it?

Keep a separate row for each carrier and waybill. Ask which pieces went into each box, then compare each arrival with the warehouse record. One delivered box does not account for every unit purchased.
Where do I see items that have been stocked at Superbuy?

The official forwarding and app guides direct customers to My Warehouse. Match the entry with your order or forwarding request. Use the domestic carrier's scan to investigate timing when the stock entry is missing.
Which photos help distinguish two otherwise identical garments?
Ask for an overview and a readable size or option label associated with each warehouse entry. Record the item reference beside the photograph before combining anything for delivery.
Can a warehouse photo confirm that an electrical item works?

A picture may show the model and visible condition. Functional testing is a separate question. Ask which inspection is available for that item and whether the requested test can actually be performed.
Should I include an item with unresolved damage in a parcel?

Check its order and contact the relevant service first. Clearly identify the affected unit and ask what remedies remain while it is still at the warehouse. Keep it off the dispatch selection until you have made a decision.
How do I compare a shipping deposit with the final charge?

Record the route, destination, contents, estimated weight and deposit at submission. Compare them with the packed dimensions, verified weight and charge in the parcel record. Check current route terms for the treatment of differences.
Do dimensions from the seller's product page describe my outbound parcel?
They may describe the item or its retail box. International estimates may depend on the outer packed parcel. Record what was measured, including its units and packaging state.
Which packing instructions should I give for fragile parts?

Describe which surfaces need separation, what must stay together, and which protective pieces should be retained. Ask whether the requested packing is available and review any charge before authorizing it.
Why might my selected shipping line change after consolidation?
The packed parcel can differ in dimensions, weight or contents from the original estimate. Check the live list of routes available for the complete parcel and its destination.
Where can I follow a parcel after Superbuy dispatches it?
The app guide directs buyers to My Parcel in the user center. Use the outbound tracking reference on that parcel, keeping earlier seller tracking numbers with their respective domestic shipments.
What should I send support about a delivered parcel missing from My Warehouse?

Include the forwarding reference, warehouse selected, carrier, waybill, delivery scan and expected contents. Explain the specific mismatch and provide the unredacted private details only through the official support channel.
How can I check whether a shipping request applies to one item or the whole parcel?

Read the service name and quantity on the order. For example, a close photo of one item and reinforcement of the outer carton concern different objects. Ask for clarification before paying for an ambiguous request.
Which record should I use for an international delivery issue?

Begin with the outbound parcel reference and current tracking event. If a particular item is affected, add its warehouse entry. Keep the package, label and relevant photos available for the investigation.
Can I use a friend's shipping estimate for my own budget?
Only as a rough comparison. Match the destination, date, route, parcel dimensions, weight and service options. Your own live quote is the relevant estimate for your shipment.
